Game Overview

In Zoo Anomaly Simulation, the core idea is straightforward: unleash your hero in a zoo gone wild. Fight mutated beasts in a haunting first-person adventure. Navigate eerie landscapes, armed and ready, to restore peace amidst chaos. Check and heal, shoot or save, in a thrilling blend of action and strategy. Can you reclaim control?
